register.labelZh: STEAL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: steal away 可以描述某人在不引人注意的情況下離開，特別適合用於帶有秘密或驚喜的故事。；steal up on somebody 可以表示某人或動物沒有發出聲音地慢慢走近，而對方並未察覺。；steal over somebody 可以描述恐懼、平靜、悲傷、安心或睡意等感覺漸漸影響某人。；這些 STEAL 片語動詞可以簡潔地營造安靜、神秘、柔和或緊張的氣氛。
register.summaryEn: Steal away lets you describe a person leaving without attracting attention, especially in stories involving secrecy or surprise. Steal up on somebody shows that a person or animal moves closer quietly without being noticed. Steal over somebody can describe fear, calm, sadness, relief, sleepiness or another feeling slowly beginning to affect a person. These STEAL expressions can make a scene feel quiet, secretive, gentle or tense without requiring a long explanation.

It describes quiet movement or a feeling arriving slowly.
